key_features_and_architecture.description: Fixed glassmorphic header with sticky backdrop blur. Includes custom minimal SVG logo mark (Cast emblem), desktop links, main CTA 'Agendar Assessoria', and Admin Login trigger.
Awwwards-level kinetic text reveal on load using Framer Motion line-by-line staggered mask. Features spotlight photography frame, trust statistics, and dual action CTAs.
Slow drift infinite ticker separating hero and services with low-contrast luxury typography highlighting key specializations.
Asymmetric bento grid breaking uniform blocks into hero cards for Passaporte Brasileiro and Visto Americano, alongside specialized diagnostic & family services.
Step-by-step interactive workflow with smooth scroll triggers highlighting 4 phases: Análise Inicial, Preenchimento & Taxas, Agendamento Estratégico, Simulação & Conclusão.

Complete booking form embedded in modal or standalone section allowing client to select Service, Date, Time slot, personal details, and special notes. Saved to persistent local storage & mock backend.
Form for general inquiries with immediate validation and Sonner toast notification.
Interactive Radix UI accordion addressing critical questions on deadlines, interview prep, DS-160, and Federal Police appointments.

Password-protected modal/dashboard view (Password: admin123) for managing all client bookings and contact requests with status updates (Pendente, Confirmado, Concluído, Cancelado), search filters, and metrics.
Rich dark footer with complete visible placeholder info (CNPJ, Address, Phone, Email, Socials) and direct link to Admin area.

instructions_to_main_agent.language_requirement: All UI elements, headings, descriptions, field labels, toasts, and sample data MUST be in Portuguese (pt-BR).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, select options, modal triggers, table status selectors) MUST include unambiguous data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-book-now-button', data-testid='admin-login-password-input').
instructions_to_main_agent.toast_rule: Use sonner for user feedback toasts on booking submission, contact form submission, admin authentication, and status updates.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_auth_rule: Implement admin panel authentication with password modal (default password: 'admin123'). Store authentication state in React state/localStorage so admin can manage bookings and contacts seamlessly.
instructions_to_main_agent.booking_storage_rule: Store bookings in local memory / localStorage pre-populated with realistic initial Portuguese consultation records so the admin table is never empty on first view.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, on distribution outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable test execution.
